observation_boundary: The root API listing was large/truncated during this pass; samples above establish non-convergence but are not claimed as an exhaustive root inventory.
why_no_bulk_move_now: Current root contains boot, authority, workflow, compatibility and tool surfaces that may be referenced by exact paths.
Historical receipts and source hashes must remain reproducible.
Moving files without a reference/dependency census can break bootstraps, GitHub workflows, tool entrypoints and external links.
A cosmetic root cleanup must not create a competing authority or silently change current execution semantics.

move_requires: repository-wide textual and workflow reference census
tests or deterministic validation for affected entrypoints

recommended_migration_phases.name: path census
actions: find every source/workflow/doc reference to each movable root entry
classify current-authority, executable-entrypoint, compatibility, generated-cache, documentation, historical-only

recommended_migration_phases.name: safe donor moves
actions: move documentation-only/technical clutter with no runtime path dependency

recommended_migration_phases.name: authority and entrypoint migration
actions: use compatibility stubs or dynamic resolver
never rewrite historical receipts to new paths

recommended_migration_phases.name: public-root acceptance
recommended_migration_phases.acceptance: Repository root contains only the four target entries, and all canonical boot/authority/install/tool paths pass their declared tests from a fresh clone.

next_exact_gate: Run a repository-wide root path/reference census against current main and emit an exact old-path -> consumer -> proposed-new-path -> compatibility requirement manifest before moving any current root technical file.
